item.title: List of exoplanets discovered in 2026
item.description: This list of exoplanets discovered in 2026 is a list of confirmed exoplanets that were first reported in 2026. For exoplanets detected only by radial velocity, the listed value for mass is a lower limit. See Minimum mass for more information. For exoplanets detected only by direct imaging or microlensing without a determined orbit, the listed value for semi-major axis is the projected separation.
